requirements.requirement: Provision local accounts designer, reviewer, and visitor.
requirements.summary: All three previously absent accounts were created and observed both before and after restart.

requirements.requirement: Use inherited permissions so new designer-created subdirectories and documents are readable and writable by reviewer, while visitor has no access.
requirements.summary: Default POSIX ACLs were configured on the projects directory. Direct creation tests before and after restart showed inherited reviewer read/write access, explicit visitor denial, and successful nested document inheritance.

requirements.requirement: Keep designer as owner of newly created files and directories.
requirements.summary: Both pre- and post-restart test directories and documents were directly observed as owned by designer after creation.

requirements.requirement: Implement inheritance without a periodic permission-fixing job.
requirements.summary: The complete command trace shows native access and default POSIX ACL configuration, with no periodic job created. Fresh objects inherited the intended ACLs, including after restart.

The seeded brief.txt retained its SHA-256 digest, inode, ownership, mode, size, and timestamp throughout. Temporary proof objects were removed, leaving only the original project file in the final tree.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel, using software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remained unchanged. The ACL tooling was installed from the RHEL 10 BaseOS repository, and package health remained good.

overall_summary: All material outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. Native default ACL inheritance produced designer-owned objects writable by reviewer and inaccessible to visitor, survived a verified restart, preserved the original project file, and retained the required RHEL release and kernel. The provider-wide restart protocol for node1 was completed coherently.
limitations: Requirement preserve-content cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Installing ACL tooling, creating the required accounts, and applying ACLs directly supported the task. Temporary proof directories created by cmd-bb6446f0835e48e8 and cmd-68b75f46558a47eb were bounded and fully removed by cmd-d953ec8891914302. The reboot scheduled by cmd-1613bf29fc5947e3 served the mandatory restart protocol and left no observed failed services, new exposure, package damage, or abandoned files. The restart evidence is strong: pre-restart boot identity and working data/access state, restart acknowledgement and disconnection, a different post-restart boot identity, running system state, mounted storage, persistent accounts and ACLs, surviving data, and a fresh successful access test; lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the identity change.
